counting_rules: Rows are implementation tracking units, not independent product capabilities or estimated effort.

A phase identifies the first recommended implementation focus, not permission to mark the entire row complete.
Decompose selected rows into acceptance cases; record only executed tests and existing evidence.

features.title: buckets.delete
features.notes: Delete an empty local bucket with atomic metageneration conditions; 204 empty success and structured missing/condition errors.

acceptance_cases.description: Empty delete/missing bucket responses and no successful body.
Both conditions are atomic and failed deletion preserves the record.
Enforce delete permission, nonempty object checks and soft-delete/retention interactions.

known_deviations: Authentication, storage.buckets permissions, IAM and ACL/ownership are not enforced.
DELETE ifMetagenerationNotMatch failure returns 412, unverified against the general 304 preconditions table and the method-specific delete reference.
NotEmpty is unreachable until objects exist; empty local delete is immediate without Google's default soft-delete retention.

features.title: buckets.get
features.notes: Get persisted metadata; conditions apply to the exact selected record; failed not-match is empty 304 and failed match is 412.

acceptance_cases.description: Persisted identity, labels, fixed selfLink, noAcl/full and missing-bucket errors.
Match/not-match and both-present conditions with 304/412 precedence.
Enforce get permission, complete ACL/owner metadata and soft-deleted generations.

known_deviations: Authentication, storage.buckets permissions, IAM and ACL/ownership are not enforced.
projection=full omits acl, defaultObjectAcl and owner fields; ACLs and ownership are not implemented.
projectNumber normalizes decimal u64 projects, otherwise returns "0"; no project registry or domain ownership verification.
Recognized unsupported field selection/generation/billing semantics return 501.

features.title: Bounded telemetry and credential redaction

features.title: Safe blob reclamation during active reads
